text.en:
Hanbros UK: Your Trusted England & United Kingdom to Turkey Logistics Partner

Hanbros UK is the official United Kingdom brand of the Han Bros group — a leading name in cross-border logistics between the UK, Europe and Turkey. Based in England with deep operational roots across London, the Midlands, the North West, Scotland, Wales and the South West, we specialise in moving personal effects, household goods, commercial freight, vehicles and express parcels from the UK to Turkey with clarity, care and full regulatory compliance.

Since our launch on hanbroscargo.co.uk, we have made it our mission to deliver more than cargo: we carry trust. Every shipment — from a single carton to a full home removal — is planned, packed, customs-cleared and tracked by a team that understands post-Brexit UK border rules, Turkish import requirements and the expectations of Turkish diaspora communities across Britain.

Our Vision & Core Values

Success for us is measured in safe delivery and a satisfied customer — not only on-time arrival. We aim to be the first name UK residents recommend for Turkey-bound shipping and removals.

  • Transparency: Clear quotes, no hidden fees. You know the cost and timeline before we collect.
  • Safety First: Professional packing, secure loading and CMR / All-Risk insurance options on every route.
  • UK–Turkey Expertise: HMRC, UK Border Force and Turkish customs procedures handled by experienced brokers on your behalf.
  • Human Service: Dedicated coordinators in English and Turkish; WhatsApp updates from collection to delivery.
  • Sustainable Operations: Efficient routing and modern fleet planning to reduce unnecessary mileage and emissions.

Why Choose Hanbros UK?

Many companies offer generic international freight. Hanbros UK is built for the United Kingdom to Turkey corridor. We understand Transfer of Residence relief, personal effects declarations, vehicle export from DVLA, commercial invoices for business stock and the seasonal peaks when Turkish communities move goods home. Whether you ship from Greater London, Birmingham, Manchester, Glasgow or Cardiff, you receive the same structured process: survey → quote → collection → UK export → sea or road transit → Turkish customs → final delivery.

UK coverage: Regular collections across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. Turkey delivery: Istanbul, Ankara, Izmir, Antalya and nationwide door-to-door service.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which UK regions do you serve?

We collect throughout the United Kingdom — Greater London, Midlands, North West England, Scotland, Wales, South West and Northern Ireland — with scheduled routes and on-request collections.

Are my goods insured during transit?

Yes. Standard CMR cover applies to international road and groupage moves. Enhanced All-Risk insurance is available for high-value or fragile items.

Do you manage UK export and Turkish import customs?

Absolutely. Our customs team prepares export declarations from the UK and coordinates import clearance in Turkey, including personal effects and vehicle documentation.

How do I get a quote?

Use the online quote form on hanbroscargo.co.uk, call our UK office or send your inventory via WhatsApp for a same-day estimate.

Hanbros UK — England origin. Turkey delivered. Every mile managed with professionalism.
